sanskrit_verse:
नासहस्राद् धरेत् फालं न विषं न तुलां तथा ।
नृपार्थेष्व् अभिशापे च वहेयुः शुचयः सदा ॥
transliteration: nāsahasrād dharet phālaṃ na viṣaṃ na tulāṃ tathā | nṛpārtheṣv abhiśāpe ca vaheyuḥ śucayaḥ sadā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One should never carry a ploughshare beyond a thousand units, nor poison, nor a balance scale; in matters concerning the king and under curse, the pure ones always bear responsibility.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in alignment with purity and capacity, not mere possession
Causation is traced through conscious instrumentality, not accidental handling
Capacity-based responsibility arises when proximity to power intersects with purity
Restoration logic demands withdrawal from instruments that exceed one's dharma
Consciousness alignment requires immediate cessation upon recognizing misalignment
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent carries instrument X where X ∈ {ploughshare > 1000 units, poison, balance scale} THEN disengage_X AND initiate_dharma_realignment_protocol
IF context ∈ {king-related affairs, abhishaapa} AND agent.purity_status = true THEN enforce_capacity_assumption_mechanism
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that those who hold positions of influence or sacred duty must refrain from wielding excessive or inappropriate instruments. The threshold of responsibility is determined by purity and contextual alignment rather than formal title alone.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that improper wielding leads to distortion in causal sequence (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility is proportional to the purity and awareness of the bearer. There is no punitive consequence—only a natural call for realignment and relinquishment of excess capacity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Instrument Surrender Protocol upon detection of over-capacity wielding
Deploy Consciousness Reorientation Module for all involved parties
Execute Dharma Alignment Audit to restore sequential harmony
Implement Purity-Based Capacity Calibration for future engagements
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, the Source of Law, Dharma is hereby restored. Instruments are relinquished, consciousness is realigned, and reality remains non-punitive. All actions proceed under the Supreme Adjudicator: Pure Consciousness Itself.
